direction.name: Photographs at uneven sizes
direction.idea: A calm page where the pictures are placed like prints on a gallery wall: each at its own size and position, with text set small and light between them. Nothing lines up in the obvious way, yet everything sits on a grid you can feel. The unevenness is what makes it read as art-directed by a person: a small portrait far left, a wide landscape running off the right edge, a square that overlaps the next section. It lets photographs lead without ever becoming a slideshow.
direction.composition: A 12-column grid with wide margins (5–7vw). The hero is a single line of large light type (6–9vw) across the top third, and below it one photograph placed off-centre (columns 6–12, 16:10), its top edge overlapping the baseline zone of the headline by a few pixels of deliberate tension. Each following section places two or three photographs with different spans and vertical offsets: for example a 3:4 portrait in columns 2–5 starting 120px lower than a 16:10 landscape in columns 7–12; then a single small 1:1 in columns 9–11 beside a paragraph in columns 2–6. Paragraphs are short (max 40ch) and sit in the gaps. No two consecutive sections use the same arrangement. Vertical spacing is large and irregular on purpose (120–260px).
direction.typography: A light or regular weight at large size for the few headings; small, quiet text. Serif or a slender sans. Everything left-aligned to grid lines.
direction.colour: A pale neutral ground with one deep ink taken from the photographs. No accent beyond a quiet link colour.
direction.imagery: Six to nine photographs from one set, in a deliberate mix of ratios (3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 16:10, 21:9). Square corners. Captions, if any, are one short line under an image in the soft ink.
direction.richness: Placement. The differing sizes and offsets create movement on a still page.
direction.pitfalls: Uneven is not random: every image edge lands on a column line, and offsets come from a small set of values. On a phone, keep the unevenness with alternating widths (100%, 72% left, 60% right) rather than stacking everything full width.

hero.name: Three prints, one line
hero.blueprint: Photographs lead and the type stays small. A pale ground, a 12-column grid, 5vw side margins. The top row at 15px holds the wordmark left, three text links centred and the single action right. Three photographs with square corners hang from one shared top line at 18% of the viewport height, like prints pinned along a rail, each a different size so their bottom edges fall at three heights. A small 1:1 in columns 1-2 (about 190px). A tall 3:4 in columns 4-7, about 440px wide and 590px tall, the largest thing on screen. A 16:10 landscape in columns 9-12 that continues past the right margin and is cropped by the viewport edge. Columns 3 and 8 are left empty as breathing space. The headline sits under the small photograph, left-aligned to its left edge across columns 1-3: a light serif or slender sans at clamp(30px, 2.8vw, 44px) on two lines, followed by one sentence at 16px in the soft ink, max 30ch. One line of caption at 14px sits under the left corner of each of the other two photographs.
hero.mobile: The rail turns vertical, so left edges vary instead of bottoms. The tall photograph comes first at 72% of the width on the left margin; the small square follows at 38% of the width, pushed to the right margin and overlapping the first by 40px; the landscape runs full bleed below. The headline at 8vw sits beside the square on the left, with the sentence at 16px under it.
hero.headline: A quiet 3-6 word line at about 40px, at most 36 characters across two lines.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Pinned title, portraits pass
sections.blueprint: A wrapper tall enough for its portraits: about 90svh per person, up to six people. A `position: sticky; top: 0` layer of 100svh holds the heading, two words at clamp(88px, 12vw, 180px), leading 0.85, centred at mid-height, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` so it reads over ground and photographs alike. Beneath it in the stacking order, portraits scroll past in normal flow: each a 4:5 photograph 26–30vw wide, alternately starting at column 2 and ending at column 11, 60svh apart, so each one passes behind a different half of the heading. Under each portrait's left corner: the name at 18px, the role at 14px in the soft ink, and one sentence of up to 30 words in a 280px measure. The last portrait is followed by 40svh of empty ground before the heading releases. Square corners. Nothing else is on screen.
sections.mobile: The heading shrinks to 17vw and pins 16px from the top instead of at mid-height. Portraits become 72% wide, alternating between the left and right margins, 48px apart, each with name, role and sentence beneath at the portrait's width.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: Staggered tiles, empty cells
sections.blueprint: A four-column grid with 16px gutters and 5vw margins in which tiles snap to columns but vary in span and height, and some cells are deliberately left empty. Pattern for eight projects: row one, a wide tile spanning columns 1–2 at 3:2 and a single tile in column 4 at 4:5, column 3 empty; row two, single tiles in columns 2 and 3, columns 1 and 4 empty; row three, a wide tile in columns 3–4 and a single in column 1. Each tile is a photograph, or a project image centred with 12% padding on a flat pastel or dark ground from the palette. Square corners, or one consistent shape detail such as a large radius on the bottom-right corner only. Under each tile one caption row at 14px: project name left, year and category right. The heading, two words stacked at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), occupies the empty cell of row one.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 10px gutters. Wide tiles span both columns; single tiles alternate left and right with the other cell left empty beside every second one, so the stagger survives. The heading sits above at 10vw. Captions stack the name over the year.

sections.name: Staggered pairs in empty ground
sections.blueprint: No heading. Photographs are placed one or two per screen so that more than half of every screen stays empty ground. Screen one: a 3:4 portrait in columns 1–4 against the left margin, and a near-square 5:4 image in columns 7–12 against the right margin whose top edge starts 30vh lower than the portrait's. Screen two: a 3:2 landscape in columns 6–11 and, 24vh lower, a small 4:5 image in columns 2–4. Repeat the two arrangements, mirrored on the second pass, for six to ten photographs. Under each image's left corner, a one-line caption at 13px in the soft ink, 10px below the image. Vertical gaps between pairs are 22–28vh. Every edge sits on a column line and offsets come from only two values. Square corners. If motion is used, images enter with a short `clip-path` wipe from the bottom edge.
sections.mobile: A single column in which widths and sides alternate: 70% against the left margin, 84% against the right, 56% left, then 100% full-bleed, with 64px between images. Captions sit under each image's left corner at 13px. Portrait crops are preferred so each image fills most of the screen height.

sections.name: Quotation over a photograph
sections.blueprint: One photograph fills the section edge to edge at 100vw by 90svh with `object-fit: cover`; choose a frame with a calm lower half. The quotation is set directly on it in the paper colour: two or three lines at clamp(36px, 5vw, 80px), leading 1.0, flush left in columns 1–9, its last baseline 64px above the bottom edge. The speaker's name and role sit at 16px on that same baseline, right-aligned in columns 10–12. For legibility, darken the whole image evenly with `filter: brightness(0.7)` instead of placing a panel behind the words; the photograph must still read as a photograph. There is no heading, no frame and no oversized quotation-mark ornament, only plain curly quotes in the text. The section butts directly against its neighbours with no margin, so the image edge is the section edge.
sections.mobile: The photograph becomes 100vw by 80svh, cropped to its strongest vertical slice. The quotation sits in the lower half at 9vw over four lines at most, flush left with 20px margins; the name and role follow under it on one line at 15px.

sections.name: Sentence, portrait, two links
sections.blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 12–18 words at clamp(26px, 3vw, 44px), four lines, leading 1.1, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
sections.mobile: The sentence comes first at 7.4vw. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

sections.name: Name across the last photograph
sections.blueprint: The footer is the page's last photograph, full-bleed at 100vw by 100svh, darkened evenly with `filter: brightness(0.62)` so paper-coloured type reads everywhere on it. Three layers of text sit on the image. Top row, 32px from the edge: a short link list at 16px at the left margin and contact details at the right margin, each no wider than three columns. Mid-height is left to the photograph. Along the bottom, the wordmark runs the full width in the paper colour, letters about 12–20vw tall depending on the name's length, baseline 56px above the edge; under it one line of legal text at 13px. Choose an image whose interest is in its middle band, since the top and bottom carry text. No panel, no box and no colour block separates the footer from the image: the photograph is the footer.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 88svh, cropped to its strongest vertical slice. Links stack at the top-left at 16px, contact beneath them. The wordmark is fitted to the width along the bottom, with the legal line under it at 12px.

references.name: Zara Webb
references.idea: A one-woman newborn-care practice presented like a hand-made keepsake: a mascot rabbit, scalloped and flower-shaped cut-outs, candid film photographs.
references.hero: Split exactly in half. Left, on cream: two-line mono caps nav stacks sit at the column's top-left and top-right with a handwritten script logo centred between them. Centred below, a five-line headline in a condensed serif, each line broken to one to three words so the block forms a ragged lozenge; then a three-line 16px sans paragraph and an outlined pill button in mono caps. A line-drawn rabbit on a skateboard rides a hairline at the column's bottom-right. Right: a candid flash photograph bleeds off the top and right edges and stops at 92% height; a lilac pill button and a round chat icon overlay its top-right corner.
references.type: Instrument Serif Regular for headings (52 to 57px, plus a 9.4vw footer wordmark), its italic for subheads and service names; Inter Tight for small body copy; PT Mono uppercase for nav, buttons and tiny captions; a script logo. Parenthesised italic numerals number the services.
references.colour: #fffdf1 #403630 #ece4d2 #e2c9f7 #cfe195 #f6e7e4 — Warm cream page with cocoa-brown text and two brown panels. Lilac marks the main pill button and footer wordmark; a sage-green pill marks a secondary action. Warm throughout.
references.imagery: Candid flash and film photos of babies and carers, some grainy black-and-white, cropped into non-rectangular masks (four-petal flower, scalloped egg) or small rounded portraits; plus black line doodles with halftone-dot fills: a recurring rabbit, flowers, a rattle, a bottle.
references.layout: 20px margins. Centred serif statements with small centred paragraphs alternate with split or inset blocks: a brown rounded panel, a half-photo half-beige block. Services run as a two-column hairline list. Doodles are tucked beside headlines; the footer's top edge is scalloped.

sections.description: A dark brown panel with about 11px radius, inset 20px from the page. Left half: a three-line cream serif statement at about 56px and below it a photograph masked into a four-lobed flower about 540px across, cropped by the panel's bottom, with two tiny mono captions floating beside its lobes. Right, from 63%: two blocks, each an italic serif subhead over a four-line small paragraph, then two flower doodles, a caps line and a lilac pill button.

A centred two-line serif heading and a four-line centred paragraph. Below, a two-column list inset to the middle 72% of the width; each item opens with a hairline, then a parenthesised italic numeral, the service name in italic serif at about 32px and a three-line small description. Rows are tall with generous empty space; the final cell swaps to a faded question prompt with the rabbit doodle.

A half-and-half block. Left: a grainy black-and-white extreme close-up of a baby's eye and cheek, full-bleed, overlapped from the bottom by a cream cut-out shaped like an egg with a scalloped top; it holds an italic serif subhead, a five-line centred paragraph, a caps line and a sage pill button. Right: a flat beige field with a centred two-line serif heading and a small rounded portrait about 230px wide flanked by two tiny mono captions.

Dark brown, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops about 120px wide. A centred three-line serif statement in cream with bottle and flower doodles at its shoulders and a waving rabbit beneath; two small centred text blocks at far left and right; contact lines and four social icons; then the name in lilac serif at 9.4vw, cropped by the bottom edge, with tiny mono legal text in both corners.

steal: Mask photographs into soft custom shapes (a four-petal flower, a scalloped egg) and let their container crop them.
Cut a section's top edge into a row of semicircles so a plain colour change becomes a motif.
Break a centred serif headline into very short lines so it forms a deliberate ragged shape, and anchor it with one small line drawing sitting on a hairline.

references.name: Sobha Privy Collection
references.idea: Luxury homes sold by restraint: a black sculptural render and a script-over-capitals title, then white pages where interior images grow and overlap huge serif capitals as you scroll.
references.hero: Full-bleed near-black video of a glossy black sculptural form, wide curved bands catching thin highlights, filling the frame at very low contrast. A centred two-line title about 46% of the width: a formal script phrase at about 6.9vw, then a line of light roman serif capitals at about 6vw directly beneath, wider than the script. Nothing else in the middle. Corners only: a two-line hamburger with a menu label top-left, a small serif wordmark with a micro subtitle top-centre, a text link top-right, a circled down-arrow bottom-left, and bottom-right a greyscale 3D-map thumbnail about 17% wide with a numeral and a two-line label.
references.type: TT Ramillas in light uppercase for display (up to 7.9vw) paired with the formal script Altesse for two- or three-word accent phrases that overlap the capitals; TT Commons Pro at 13px for nav, eyebrows and body. A very large jump from 100px display to 13px text.
references.colour: #010101 #ffffff #d8cdbd #8a7862 #1a1919 — Black hero, then pure white pages with near-black type. Warmth comes only from the beige, cream and bronze interiors in the renders. No accent colour anywhere.
references.imagery: Architectural interior renders in cream and bronze (double-height dining halls, lounges, marble pool rooms) in tall portrait and near-square crops, square corners, arranged in groups of different sizes that scale with scroll. The hero is an abstract black sculptural render.
references.layout: Centred, symmetrical compositions (heading over a three-image group) alternate with asymmetric ones (large left-aligned capitals with images offset right and lower-left). A very long scroll-driven page of about 48 screens, with pinned image scaling between text moments.

sections.description: White section, centred. A two-line micro eyebrow in tracked capitals, then a two-line heading in light serif capitals at about 2.6vw. Below it a triptych: a tall centre image about 23vw wide at 3:4, flanked by two shorter images set lower, their tops about 30% down the centre image and their outer edges touching the viewport sides. On scroll the centre image scales up and the side images rise toward its top.

Pinned scaling group: the same three renders rearranged so the centre image is about 26vw wide and roughly 30% taller than its neighbours, which hang from a common line a little below its top and are cropped by the left and right viewport edges. Gaps are under 1vw. The fixed header stays above, its logo sitting on top of the image.

Statement with overlap: five lines of light serif capitals at about 5.5vw, flush left on a 1% margin, filling the left 55%. A grey script phrase overlaps the end of the last line and runs into a tall image occupying the right 25% from mid-height to the bottom. A second, small image about 12vw wide sits lower left under the text. Mid-transition frames show the capitals rising letter by letter from behind a baseline mask.

steal: Pair one short phrase in formal script with a line of light serif capitals beneath it, letting the script overlap the capitals or run into an adjacent image.
Arrange three images as a tall centre flanked by two lower ones cropped by the viewport edges, then scale the centre up on scroll.
Keep the hero to a near-black, low-contrast render with all controls pushed to the four corners so the centred title is the only bright thing.
